title: Patch Notes 1.24.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.24.0

Raiders!

Patch 1.24.0 is being deployed now across all platforms. The Nascosto Set and the Scrappy Speckled Set are now available in the shop, alongside a set of fixes listed below. A game restart is required to download the update.

* Several crash-causing issues have been resolved.

* An issue causing the Vanguard Set to stretch other players' models has been corrected.

* An issue where players and ARC could sound quieter than they should when out of line of sight on Stella Montis has been fixed.

* An issue producing blurry visuals when AMD FSR Frame Generation was turned on has been fixed.

* A rare case where ziplines could be attached to carriables sitting on a ledge's edge while the player stood below has been fixed.

* An issue where hold-to-use items (like bandages) could trigger automatically when a quick slot swap got interrupted by pressing the fire key has been fixed.

* Raiders who put effort into the Weather Monitor Station Project but were unable to finish it in time should check their in-game inbox over the coming days. Also note that the High-Gain Antenna Project will expire before the Riven Tides update arrives.

A store rotation is planned for next week, but no patch is scheduled ahead of the Riven Tides update, which arrives at the end of April. The team is focused entirely on finishing the remaining details of the new map and its content.

See you topside,

Ossen
